description: Look up dietary supplement labels from the NIH Dietary Supplement Label Database (DSLD) and total vitamin and mineral intake across a list of supplements, compared with NIH recommended amounts (RDA/AI) and daily upper limits (UL). POST JSON, get a JSON object. /v1/products/search {query|brand|ingredient, limit<=10} -> product summaries. /v1/products/get {dsld_id|dsld_ids<=10} -> normalized labels (label amount kept next to converted amount). /v1/nutrients/reference {nutrient, age, sex} -> rda, ear, ai, ul (offline). /v1/stack/analyze {age?, sex?, products:[{dsld_id}|{name, ingredients:[{name, amount, unit}]}] <=15} -> per-nutrient daily totals, percent of RDA/UL, above_ul/below_reference flags, overlaps, data gaps and assumptions, each number traced to its label and NIH fact sheet. Results vary as DSLD updates. Label and reference data only; not medical advice; drug and supplement interactions are not assessed (see Pocket services med-safety and fda for medications).

rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/products/search, /v1/products/get, /v1/nutrients/reference, /v1/stack/analyze, /v1/tool; GET /v1/health, /v1/version, /openapi.json. All responses are JSON objects; errors are 4xx JSON with a stable error.code.

specs.notes: Pinned to tag v0.1.0. Also served by every backend at GET /openapi.json.

serving.backend: The dietary-supplement-analysis container (Node 22) behind the HA RelayMiner with the rest backend pointed at http://<backend>:8080. No auth toward the backend; callers cannot send headers. Needs outbound HTTPS to api.ods.od.nih.gov.
serving.notes: Optional DSLD_API_KEY. Max 15 products per analyze call. DSLD calls are cached (labels 7 d) and capped at 8 s per request; typical response under 3 s warm. Gateway operators: type passthrough, rpc_types ["rest"], relay_timeout 30s.
